statement.zh: Driessen & Macdonald《The Troubled Island》(1997) 综合讨论锡拉喷发前后新宫殿克里特的破坏与变迁证据。
statement.en: Driessen & Macdonald The Troubled Island (1997) synthesizes destruction and change evidence for Neopalatial Crete around the Theran eruption.
